description: The file is a partial code-behind class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page (AdminCourseQueue.aspx), handling page events, button clicks, and grid selection in an admin queue interface of an online examination system.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing the admin course queue page, handling user interactions and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handler for profile button click; currently does nothing.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles grid row selection, storing the course ID in session and redirecting back to the same page.
